official_definition: However, Dan Kuroto Deus Advent differs in that it specifies that the core must be moved from a "Dan Kuroto"-named Nexus. Currently, the only card to have this effect is Kamen Rider Genm God Maximum Gamer Level Billion.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Dan Kuroto Deus Advent] or [Dan Kuroto Deus Advent: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Dan Kuroto Deus Advent]", "give [Dan Kuroto Deus Advent]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
